title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1968-08-21
lineage: SBD > MR > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: A pristine sound‑board capture of the legendary 8/21/68 show with Jerry’s guitar tone on fire and a blistering second set highlighted by Dark Star, The Eleven and Alligator.
ai_review.review: The recording is an exceptionally clear sound‑board source that showcases Garcia’s crunchy tube‑amp tone and surprisingly low hiss for the era, despite some minor splicing quirks and track‑indexing oddities. Musically the band is in top form – Phil’s bass “bombs”, Pigpen’s organ swirls, and a high‑energy set that peaks with Dark Star → St. Stephen → The Eleven and an all‑out Alligator jam. Overall it feels like one of the quintessential 1968 performances.

ai_rating.rationale: The vast majority of reviews are 5‑star, praising both performance and sound; only a few note minor hiss or editing issues, so the combined show (70%) and recording (30%) rating is very high.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp, clear mix with Garcia’s guitar tone front‑and‑center; a bit of tape hiss and occasional flatness noted, plus some splicing/track‑cutting quirks that don’t detract from overall listenability.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong flow with a tight first set and a second‑set that builds into an epic Dark Star → St. Stephen → Eleven sequence; transitions are praised even though a few track cuts interrupt the continuity.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly lauded for his soaring, crunchy guitar tone, fiery solos (Mountain Jam theme), and strong vocal presence throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as “insane” and “bombing” on bass; multiple reviewers note his powerful interplay with Garcia especially during Dark Star and The Eleven.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ is highlighted as beautiful, well‑mic’d, and integral to the jam sections (Alligator, Dark Star). Some mention Tom C. on organ for Schoolgirl.
band_member_comments.Drums: The drum break is noted as a key moment feeding into the Alligator jam; overall drumming considered solid and driving.
